not_sufficient: Memory requery alone without native inspection
Final source differs but the transition evidence is missing
positive_requires: Prior visible reliance statement or stale-consistent application action is identified.
Subsequent native read/search/test output supplies relevant current evidence, with exact quote and source binding.
A later public statement rejects/revises the fact or an observable action replaces the stale application with one consistent with that native evidence.
All three events have a supported order; preserve the earlier positive label rather than erase it.
correction_after_native_inspection.qualification: Observed revision is not a claim about an internal belief update or that native inspection caused it.

not_sufficient: Mentioning or quoting old text without endorsement
Planning to consult memory before seeing a fact
Private/visible reasoning block used as a proxy for internal cognition
positive_requires: Assistant public text endorses or applies the same stale atomic fact as current, or explicitly uses it to justify a proposed action/conclusion.
Exact quote and fact linkage, with source timing/assessability and competing evidence recorded.
explicit_reliance.qualification: A statement citing memory is a visible self-report, not proof of a counterfactual causal effect.

not_sufficient: Tool was invoked but failed or output is missing
positive_requires: Exact stale atomic fact appears in an authenticated model-visible returned tool response.
Staleness basis verified for the time/scope, and response content/record ID binds to catalog or valid compact audit receipt.

not_sufficient: Native grep/read of the old name for verification
Deliberate negative/compatibility test using an obsolete API
Action works under both old and current facts without specific obsolete dependence
positive_requires: Exact tool input/diff/visible command or final statement matches the stale atomic fact in an intended current application.
Known temporal relation: exposure precedes action, or attribution is explicitly non-memory/unknown.
Retain attempted action and its result separately; failed patch/call is still a visible attempt.
observable_action.qualification: Consistency is a descriptive association. Report alternate sources/intent and do not rename it memory-caused action or behavioral incorrectness.

rules: Primary analysis uses authenticated literal comparisons in the supplied scope. A 2400-character prefix comparison establishes only that prefix, not complete-body or behavioral equivalence.
A source hash must be bound to actual source bytes/checkpoint; a hash of rendered read output is not a full-file hash.
Typed predicates require an explicit supplied frozen reference decision; do not invent one.
Withheld catalog content visible only to the reviewer is not content exposed to the trial agent.

coverage_and_aggregation.all_attempts: Create roster before review from frozen plan plus attempt/terminal/partial records. Missing or failed trials retain a row and reason; active trials are not inspected until terminal snapshot/freeze.
coverage_and_aggregation.correction: Correction is reported conditional on a prior visible positive episode, retaining counts of initial reliance/action and subsequent revision.
coverage_and_aggregation.counts: Report each axis separately by arm and stage: attempted roster, model admitted, assessable trials, positive trials, positive episodes, unknown/unassessable, not applicable and coverage gaps. Never collapse axes into one stale-use number.
coverage_and_aggregation.denominators: Show positive/Nattempted as an observed-evidence count with unknowns separately, plus positive/Nassessable. Plain external-memory exposure is not applicable, not a zero measure of all stale knowledge.
coverage_and_aggregation.non_independence: Repeated calls/records/episodes within trial/task/repetition are dependent observations; do not treat them as independent samples or sum overlapping axes.
prohibited_claims: Memory caused a failure solely because an action is compatible with old text
Annotation syntax change as proven behavioral API break
AI majority vote as human/ground-truth validation

evaluator_identity.role: Evidence-backed visible-behavior annotation; not a human evaluation or internal cognition measurement.

quote.limits: Each quote at most800characters; up to3 contiguous separately located quotes per event. Select only the necessary supporting/contradicting passage. Never concatenate separated text as one quote. Preserve a full immutable transcript pointer for context.
quote.locator: JSON Pointer into authenticated messages.json or one-based JSONL line plus JSON Pointer. Quote offsets are zero-based Unicode codepoints into the identified parsed string, not bytes. Hash raw artifact and UTF-8 parsed string separately.
quote.null_ids: If a public artifact has no message/tool ID, use null plus reason and the exact artifact locator; never invent an ID.

stale_fact.null_hash_rule: If native output is partial, retain output/excerpt hash and exact line/character scope; full source SHA256 is null. Do not label display hash a module hash.

rules: Unknown/shell/executing tools count as potential writes from start; a failed tool may have partially written.
Read-only tools are classified by frozen tool catalog, not guessed from success or command text.
Concurrent/overlapping tools and missing timestamps do not establish before/after from JSON serialization order alone.
Canonical reset source supports comparisons only before any prior/overlapping potential write, unless a contemporaneous source checkpoint proves the relevant state.

non_inference_rules: Do not infer private reasoning, attention, remembered internal state or chain of thought. Exclude reasoning/native/encrypted provider fields from packets.
Exposure does not establish reliance; a compatible action does not establish that memory caused it.
Changed file, changed literal or changed annotation syntax alone does not prove a false behavioral claim or API break.
Absence of visible evidence is not zero internal or causal reliance.
Use the exact source state at the statement/action time; final candidate source cannot stand in for earlier source.
Preserve attempted, failed, interrupted and partial trials. Never sample only stale-exposed, unsuccessful or static-arm cases.
Redacted/partial/ambiguous evidence stays unknown; never reconstruct private values or silently substitute historical data.

proposed_review_protocol.blinding: Opaque packet IDs and frozen randomized ordering; withhold aggregate scores/arm rankings/gold/evaluator outputs. Preserve backend/trust/freshness text when necessary for faithful evidence: full arm blinding is then impossible and must be disclosed.
proposed_review_protocol.costs: Extraction/packet construction, review/adjudication model calls, wall/CPU/token/resource/storage costs are offline evaluation infrastructure, recorded separately from trial totals. No free evaluation-cost assumption.
proposed_review_protocol.disagreement: Retain both original judgments and exact evidence. Report agreement/disagreement per axis; if adjudicating use separately labelled AI adjudication with all original labels retained, never silent human/ground-truth substitution.
freeze_before_review: input roster/snapshot and source evidence inventories
packet order seed and packetizer limits
proposed_review_protocol.limits: Never silently truncate a transcript. If a complete public packet cannot fit frozen limits, label oversize_unassessable and retain in denominator until a separate chunking protocol is frozen.
proposed_review_protocol.preferred_reviews: Two fresh AI review contexts per trial packet, same rubric/prompt/model/settings and evidence schema across arms; no shared previous annotations until both originals are sealed. Root must freeze this choice before calls.

scope: Offline AI annotation of public completed/attempted trial transcripts and authenticated source-context evidence. This stage contains no trial annotations.

units.atomic_fact: A smallest exact source statement, identifier, signature fragment, literal code context or typed predicate with authenticated contemporaneous comparison; not an entire changed file.
units.attempt_definition: Use the frozen controller lifecycle/attempt-start record, not successful model completion. Preserve separate model_admitted and transcript_available flags.
units.episode: One fact plus its specific exposure and subsequent visible evidence chain within a trial. Repeated observations remain linked to the same fact and are not independent samples.
units.non_memory: Plain and memory arms may contain stale-looking actions from native/docs/unknown sources; retain them separately rather than attributing them to external memory.
units.roster: Every registered trial gets a coverage row; every attempted trial stays in attempted denominator. Planned but unattempted trials are listed separately.
